description: This file defines the QueueAdapter class, a custom ArrayAdapter used to display a list of media queue items in an Android media browsing application. It manages view recycling, highlights the active queue item, and binds data from MediaSession.QueueItem objects to list item views.

classes.name: QueueAdapter
classes.description: A list adapter for items in a media queue, extending ArrayAdapter<MediaSession.QueueItem>, managing view creation and binding queue item data.

methods.name: QueueAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and an empty list of queue items.

methods.name: setActiveQueueItemId
methods.description: Sets the currently active/selected queue item ID, used to highlight the active item.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles list item views, binds MediaSession.QueueItem data to UI elements, and updates icons based on active item.
